home.features.subtitle: Amathuluzi agcwele okuphathwa kwengcebo nokuhlelwa kwama-trust akhelwe imindeni yaseNingizimu Afrika
home.features.trustBuilderDesc: Umhlahlandlela wesinyathelo ngesinyathelo wokwakha i-trust onamathemplethi omthetho nezibheko zokuhambisana. Khiqiza ama-trust aphilayo nawasefa ngemibhalo ezenzakalelayo.
home.features.documentVaultDesc: Ukugcinwa okuphephile kwamadokhumenti onke engcebo ngokukhipha inani ngokuzenzakalela, ukuqinisekiswa kwe-crypto, nokulandelela impahla.
home.features.wealthTrackingDesc: Ukuqapha i-phothifoliyo ngesikhathi sangempela ngezibalo zobungcweti, ukubalwa kwe-net worth, amashadi okusatshalaliswa kwezimpahla, nezibikezelo zokukhula.
home.features.clientManagementDesc: Kwabachwepheshe bezomthetho: phatha ama-phothifoliyo amakhasimende amaningi, landela i-AUM, futhi ukhiqize imibiko yobungcweti kusuka kukhasibhodi elilodwa elinamandla.
home.features.cryptoVerificationDesc: Ukuqinisekisa okuthuthukisiwe kwezimali ze-cryptocurrency ngokuhlola amakheli e-wallet, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-KYC, nobufakazi bobunikazi ukuvimbela inkohliso.
home.features.educationAcademyDesc: Funda kahle ukuhlelela ingcebo ngamamojula ayi-6 e-vidiyo, ama-quiz anokusebenzisana, nezitifiketi zokuqeda zokuphathwa kwe-trust.
home.features.professionalReportsDesc: Khiqiza imibiko ye-PDF ebanzi enezifingqo zengcebo, izakhiwo zama-trust, kanye nemibhalo yokuhambisana yamakhasimende.
